_about: Every 3D LAGP asset of Battle Blood. gen_concepts.py and gen_models.py read this. Seeds fixed so jobs can be re-made. White cloth on units/shields/tents is what the team tint recolours, so one model serves both armies.
light: Flat even ambient lighting from all sides, no directional light, no cast shadows, no shading highlights, unlit albedo colours

infantry.prompt: medieval foot soldier man, dark steel chainmail hauberk and mail coif, plain pure white cloth tabard over the mail, brown leather belt, dark steel nasal helmet, dark grey hose, dark brown leather boots, dark leather gloves, empty hands, no weapons

archer.prompt: medieval longbow archer man, plain pure white linen tunic with a white hood, brown leather jerkin, brown leather bracers on the forearms, dark grey hose, brown leather boots, short beard, empty hands, no weapons

cavalry.prompt: medieval mounted knight man wearing a long plain pure white sleeveless cloth surcoat that covers his chest and belly down to the knees, bright polished silver chainmail sleeves and mail chausses under it, bright silver steel plate pauldrons and knee cops, brown leather belt over the surcoat, bright polished silver steel great helm with eye slit, light grey steel gauntlets, dark brown leather boots, empty hands, no weapons
cavalry._note: 2026-11-05: the dark steel version (seed 1313) textured as black lumps with no plate detail; set aside in models/_set_aside/cavalry_darksteel.

horse.prompt: photorealistic medieval war horse destrier gelding, chestnut brown coat, black mane, long full black tail lifted and streaming straight out behind the rump in the wind, the tail held high and well clear of the hind legs, clear gap between all four legs, plain pure white saddle blanket on its back, brown leather saddle and bridle, no rider
horse._note: 2026-11-06: full tail held out behind (along the rig's tail bones, clear of the hind legs). The docked-tail horse is kept in models/_set_aside/horse_docked_tail.

sword.view: strict front view, standing upright with the point up
